title: BESSELI and BESSELK: one joint 18/18 over the x >= 8 band
status_plain: A similar-risk scan probed BESSELI and BESSELK together over the x >= 8 band, which the source describes as previously unprobed, and reports 18 of 18 live rows bit-exact with no action taken. This is ONE figure over TWO surfaces: no per-surface split exists anywhere. The W109 work tree has no Bessel batch or answers files at all, the elem-probe directory is absent from the tree, and bessel_convert_family.rs carries witness-table regression tests only for bessely and besselj - there is no BESSELI or BESSELK pin test. Nothing was fitted to these 18 rows because no BESSELI/BESSELK fix was made, and the band is called previously unprobed, so they are effectively fresh - but the source never uses the word held-out. Note that the same sentence's rows may overlap the 92-row BESSELJ/I/K probe set that fed the coefficient fit; the source does not resolve that.
